meta.name: Scares by Shudder
meta.description:
Brace yourself for a good scare. Tune into endless, edge-of-your-seat programming with Scares by Shudder. Featuring a human-curated selection of horrors, thrillers, and the supernatural.

Shows: Creepshow, Tales From the Crypt, A Creepshow Animated Special, Reef, The, Mandrake
Available on: The Roku Channel, Plex
